svg.title: A decorated name and its wrapper
svg.desc: Tag 1: a gray box, the module's namespace, holds the name drive_time. It has an arrow to a red box, a function object named wrapper. Tag 2: the wrapper's __closure__ has an arrow down to a cell object for the name func. The cell has an arrow to tag 3: a function object named drive_time, the function that def drive_time made.
